countdown: All stations are Go. Here we go.

maxq.name: MAX-Q
maxq.pass: Through the roughest air. Holding together.
maxq.fail: The rocket could not take the strain.

separation.name: SEPARATION
separation.fail: The boosters did not separate cleanly.

orbit.name: ORBIT
orbit.pass: Engine cut-off. We are in orbit!
orbit.fail: Not enough speed to stay in orbit.

skipped: Something is pulling the capsule up...

lightning.saved: The crew resets the systems. Still flying.
lightning.lost: The strike knocked out the controls.

life_support.saved: The crew patches it. Air is flowing again.
life_support.lost: Life support failed, and it could not be fixed in time.

solar.saved: The crew works it loose. Power is back.
solar.lost: Without the panel, the power ran out.

power.saved: The crew shuts down everything extra. Just enough.
power.lost: The power ran out before help could arrive.
